issues.title: The icon of force get wrong path for game play
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Create a new game then play game with any role. Notice  icon of force is wrong path so It can not show icon.

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Login app as admin
2. Create a new game 
3. Play game with any role 
4. Notice  icon of force is wrong path (It gets duplicate 'http://localhost:8080'). So It can not show icon.

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/63000c39-b19a-41fd-8f29-494219628a65)

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Should enable to show icon of force

## 🖥️ Screenshots


## 💻 System information
 - Browser : Chrome
 - Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111

## 📝 Additional context
